decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet sits close to the core offer and still has its own page in 2024, so it costs little to keep while demand evidence accumulates, though the sibling carpet C was already dropped.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a premium craftsmanship piece with low holding costs in the collection and continued dedicated presentation, so the option is worth keeping open.
The corner bench lost its own page but is still promoted as a new interpretation in 2024, signalling continued commitment while its value is still uncertain, so keeping it remains cheap.
This low-pile carpet remains presented on its own page and fits the established rug range, so dropping it is not yet justified despite the firm holding many similar carpet options.
The swivel shell chair line with several models has steady dedicated presentation and supports both residential and contract business, so it merits further commitment.
